observations.text: PIP-2400 spool erection completed on Pipe Rack B tier 2, 450 inch-dia installed.
Hydro test of P-101 held at pressure and line reinstatement finished.
RACK-B pipe erection is 80% complete in Zone 2.
35 MT rebar binding and shuttering completed for FND-C-101 at compressor house.
Concrete pour commenced for COL-FTG-100 in Area 100; 120 cu.m placed.
CIV-1100 reinforcement WIP at compressor foundation, physical progress 65%.
Cold shaft alignment of pump P-101A completed after coupling check.
Final grouting for P-101A pump is done in CDU area.
ELE-3100 cable traying WIP in Area 100; 280 m installed.
Power cable glanding and termination completed at MCC-01 in substation 4.
PT-101 bench calibration and impulse line hookup witnessed by QC.
Loop check for FT-202 completed from field JB to DCS.
Scaffold green tag inspection completed at Rack B before work permit release.
Third party witnessed pressure testing for crude feed header P-101.
Crew attendance recorded and lunch packets delivered to camp office.
General housekeeping completed near the warehouse parking area.
